name: JARVIS
summary: JARVIS is PIA Automation’s full-size humanoid service-robot range for reception, guided explanations and performances. The current manufacturer listing describes face recognition, conversational question answering, scripted gestures, autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance. PIA identifies its AI and Humanoid Robotics Research Institute as the developer of JARVIS 1.0 and 2.0. This record follows the current product name JARVIS; the pictured configuration is not assigned an unverified generation suffix, and current delivery availability remains unverified.
